items.exampleEn: I love the smell of coffee.
She gave me a box of chocolates.
In Taiwan, people eat rice every day.
items.exampleZh: 在台灣，大家每天都吃米飯。

items.exampleEn: Some families eat turkey at Christmas.
items.exampleZh: 有些家庭聖誕節會吃火雞。

items.audioEn: What is that smell? Is Mom making a chocolate cake?
items.audioZh: 那是什麼味道？媽媽在做巧克力蛋糕嗎？
items.questionZh: 說話者覺得媽媽在做什麼？

items.sentenceZh: 這個巧克力蛋糕很好吃。

items.sentenceEn: We have turkey for Christmas dinner.

items.stemEn: Good morning! ____ is ready. Come and eat.
I love the ____ of hot bread.
items.stemZh: 我很喜歡剛出爐麵包的香味。

items.passageEn: Today is my birthday. In the morning, I wake up to a great smell. My dad is making breakfast: rice, eggs, and corn soup. In the evening, my mom brings home a big chocolate cake. Everyone eats a piece. It is a great day!
items.passageZh: 今天是我的生日。早上，我被一股很香的味道叫醒。爸爸正在做早餐：飯、蛋和玉米湯。晚上，媽媽帶了一個大巧克力蛋糕回家，每個人都吃了一塊。真是美好的一天！

questions.questionZh: 媽媽晚上帶了什麼回家？

referenceEn: I usually have rice and eggs for breakfast.
I usually eat rice and an egg for breakfast.
rubricZh: 「早餐吃⋯」可用 for breakfast（例如 eggs for breakfast），也可寫 My breakfast is usually…
usually 通常放在一般動詞前（放句首也可以）
蛋可寫 eggs 或 an egg

items.instructionZh: 用 cake 造一個句子，說說你喜歡的蛋糕，或你什麼時候吃蛋糕。
referenceEn: We eat cake on my birthday.
rubricZh: 泛指蛋糕時不加 a（例如 I love cake）；說種類可加名稱（例如 chocolate cake）
一整個蛋糕用 a cake，一塊用 a piece of cake
